name: Court Reporters
tagline: Find certified court reporters and stenographers near you
description: The most comprehensive directory of court reporters and stenographers in the United States
cityPagePromptContext:
Court reporters (also called stenographers) create verbatim transcripts
of legal proceedings including depositions, trials, hearings, and
arbitrations. They use stenotype machines, voice writing, or digital
recording to capture testimony. Many offer realtime reporting, rough
drafts, and expedited transcript delivery. Attorneys, law firms, and
courts hire them for civil and criminal proceedings.

editorialAuthor.name: Nick Palmer
editorialAuthor.title: Founder & Lead Researcher
editorialAuthor.bio: After years working in the legal services industry, Nick built this directory to help attorneys and legal professionals find qualified court reporters without the guesswork.
